### Palestinian Fundraiser with Carmel McMahon

![Carmel McMahon](carmel-McMahon.jpeg)

Join us for a night of music, poetry, stories and solidarity for the Palestinian people, featuring author Carmel McMahon.

An art raffle will be announced leading up to the event. All proceeds will go directly to the Palestine Red Crescent Society.

### About the Palestine Red Crescent Society

The Palestine Red Crescent Society (PRCS) is a humanitarian organization that provides emergency medical services, healthcare, and social services to Palestinians in need. Your support will help them continue their vital work.

[Learn more about PRCS](https://www.palestinercs.org/en)
